name: comvivo-monorepo
description: Comvivo — the open-source AI that belongs to your group, not to one person.

scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run depcruise && pnpm run brand:check && pnpm run names:check && pnpm run supply:check && pnpm run secrets:check && pnpm run hygiene:check && pnpm run renovate:check && pnpm run prose && pnpm run plan:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run docs:build && pnpm run evals:smoke
scripts.depcruise:graph: depcruise packages apps --config --output-type dot | dot -T svg > reports/dependency-graph.svg
scripts.bench: node scripts/pending.mjs "pnpm bench" M1-T32 "run the B-suite micro and macro benchmarks and compare against the 01 §11.10 budgets" "nothing yet: vitest 5.0.5 does not expose a usable bench API, so M1-T32 chooses the harness (see STATUS Plan changes)"
scripts.evals:live: node scripts/pending.mjs "pnpm evals:live" M2-T19 "run the eval suites against real models, inside the approved budget" "pnpm evals:smoke, which uses the deterministic fake gateways"
scripts.dev: node scripts/pending.mjs "pnpm dev" M3-T42 "run the server and dashboard in watch mode on the simulator channel" "pnpm test:watch"
scripts.db:generate: node scripts/pending.mjs "pnpm db:generate" M1-T14 "generate a drizzle migration from the schema" "nothing — there is no schema until M1"
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/pending.mjs "pnpm db:migrate" M1-T14 "apply pending drizzle migrations to the database" "nothing — there is no schema until M1"
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && node -e "for (const p of ['node_modules/.cache','.turbo','reports','.vitest','coverage']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
